main_measure.name: mean unusual 5-bar move of short bets (short direction), day-pooled t

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases pooled by day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move, larger-short half minus smaller-short half

decided_by: Mean unusual move positive with t >= 2 and the supporting check above 0 (confirm rule).
reading: Profile read as the recorded regime not being 'chop'; a case is the first short bet in each 5-bar grid cell of a window; the day-pooled t sums deviations per signal day with a G/(G-1) correction; the larger-short half is |forecast| above the median, the smaller half at or below it; the plan's 'fewer than 30 cases on distinct days' is applied as the minimum count.

direction_check.why: too few cases on the check folds (79 cases, 79 days)
